_comment: The SHAPE a real OCI registry returns, not an npm response wearing an OCI label. Docker Hub names the tag in `name` (with the leading v the git tag carries), puts the index digest in `digest`, and lists per-architecture digests under `images` -- there is no `versions` array and no `dist.integrity`, which is exactly why the npm-shaped reader could never admit one. Captured from hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/.../tags/v2026.8.3 on 2026-08-12.
